results.title: Real Madrid's Jose Mourinho happy with squad despite losing out on Rodri
results.description: Real Madrid coach Jose Mourinho said Tuesday he is " very happy" with his squad, which he considers complete despite missing out on midfielder Rodri, later signed by rivals Barcelona.

results.title: Cloverleaf football ends 11-game losing streak to Buckeye
results.description: Cloverleaf beat county rival Buckeye 10-6 for its first football win in 12 meetings, while Medina-area teams opened the fall sports season in soccer, golf and tennis.
